name: Texas
status_why: Civix answered scripts behind Cloudflare without a challenge; Nov 3 is election 53815.
system: Civix election night results ('Civix Election Night Results', goelect.txelections.civixapps.com, behind Cloudflare but answering scripts); answers are base64 JSON.

results_page.label: Texas Secretary of State: election night results

election.how_to_find: Listed; the data loads on the night.

feeds.address: https://goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/api-ivis-system/api/s3/enr/electionConstants (list of elections, base64 JSON in 'upload'); https://goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/api-ivis-system/api/s3/enr/election/<ID> (record with base64 sections Home, Federal, StateWide, StateWideQ, Districted, OfficeSummary, Race, Lookups, ReportList)
feeds.updates: Home carries RefreshTime and LastUpdatedTime; counties report through the night (CountiesReporting CR of CT=254)
feeds.note: HTTP 200 (cloudflare) on 2026-10-09. The Nov 3 election (ID 53815, 'O': N) currently returns only {'Version'}: the data is not loaded yet. The March primary record (53813) is 1.8 MB.

feeds.address: Federal section of /election/<ID>: Races[] with Candidates[] carrying V (votes), EV (early votes), PE (percent), P (party)

feeds.note: The kit already reads the OfficialCanvassReport this way.

races_in_feed: statewide judges and courts of appeals
special elections (House 93, Senate 22 on Nov 3: IDs 66734, 66618)
local: Yes, for county, city and school races: Harris (harrisvotes.com), Dallas (dallascountyvotes.org), Tarrant (tarrantcountytx.gov elections), Bexar (bexar.org elections), Travis (votetravis.gov). Not requested.
how_counted: Texas reports early votes apart from Election Day votes.
count_order: EV (early votes) beside V (total); mail not split from early in-person.
vote_types: Yes: each candidate has EV (early votes) beside V (total), so election-day votes are V minus EV. Mail is not split from early in-person in the fields seen.

certify.body: the Governor of Texas (the state canvass)
certify.rule: Between the 18th and the 33rd day after the election, at a time the Secretary of State sets (Tex. Elec. Code 67.012); governor and lieutenant governor are canvassed by the Legislature (67.011).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: results.texas-election.com (2019-2024 site): Cloudflare challenge, not asked (per ballot/lists/tx.py).
scout_plan: Read /election/53815 (and the two specials) every few minutes on election night; the reader for the format exists in tx.py. Congress, statewide and legislative results with early-vote splits come straight from it, county by county via the Race section if present (to confirm on the primary record). County and city results need the big counties' own sites, largest first.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
